payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses Stirling numbers of the second kind to expand x^k into falling factorials, then computes sum_{j} S(k,j) * (N)_j * 2^{N-j} with DP to generate S(k,j).
payload.rationale: The solution precomputes Stirling numbers using a 1D DP (row-wise generation) and then applies a combinatorial formula; the DP is auxiliary, fitting dp_counting_combinatorics.
